copy.title: Financial technology companies: a dataset-led funding overview
copy.metaDescription: Explore financial technology companies in this supplied dataset, with fundraising figures, regional context and a complete company ranking.
copy.introduction: This dataset brings together 100 companies working across financial technology. Recorded fundraising for 100 companies totals £622,301,270, offering a view of the businesses included in this collection.

sections.heading: A closer look at funding
sections.body: Median recorded fundraising is £4,146,786. The ranking makes it possible to compare the companies within this dataset without treating it as a complete market census.

sections.heading: Read the companies behind the figures
sections.body: Company descriptions and industry labels provide context for the funding data. Missing information remains unknown and the source records are preserved in the table below.
